gold_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE importers(file_id) AS (
  SELECT i.file_id FROM code.imports i
  WHERE i.imported_file_id = 'auto_ontology/semantic/constants.py'
  UNION
  SELECT i.file_id FROM code.imports i
  JOIN importers m ON i.imported_file_id = m.file_id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN split_part(f.file_id, '/', 3) = '' THEN split_part(f.file_id, '/', 1)
            ELSE split_part(f.file_id, '/', 1) || '/' || split_part(f.file_id, '/', 2) END AS area,
       COUNT(*) AS files
FROM importers m
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = m.file_id
WHERE NOT f.is_test
GROUP BY area
ORDER BY files DESC, area;
